criteria.detail: Asserted every round in the loop: what leaves held plus parked equals what was taken, and what the cap leaves uncollected is recorded and not carried. criteria.detail: Printed, not judged. Every rule against the one-sided twin on the same carrier and seed, at the close. **The instrument's own range comes first, because a grid that cannot move the count says nothing when it reads no movement**: over 675 two-sided cell-seeds the count below the floor differs from the one-sided twin by {0: 639, 1: 18, 75: 18}, so a block of 50 or more moves in 18 of them. Against that: 75 comparisons of all 9 two-sided rules at a fixed carrier and seed, 0 leaving a different count; and 0 of those comparisons have the single-position rules and the mixes reaching different counts. Block states: block under = 50 or more nodes more below the floor than the reference at the close; block lifted = 50 or more fewer; no block = everything else, printed as A30-3's own six states beside it. Carrier states: the ratio decides = at a fixed carrier and seed the rules do not all leave the same count below the floor, and the spread of what they collected is at or under 0.0191; the setpoint decides = they all leave the same count, so on this carrier neither the ratio nor the shape settles it; differs, and so do the totals: not adjudicated = the counts differ and the collected totals differ by more than 0.0191, so the aggregate channel is open and this carrier is read neither way. Carriers by reading: the setpoint decides 15. Where they differ: nowhere.
